name: Sean Boyce
biography: is a founding member of Foulab (www.foulab.org), the Montreal hackerspace, and holds a MSc in Renewable Resources. He studies tree diseases, and enjoys statistics. He has lived in a swamp for months, has genetically modified organisms twice, and has never taken a course in computers or engineering in his life. He only codes in assembly language, and to the best of his knowledge, is incapable of perceiving boredom. His next project is to start a custom flex-PCB printing business (Legion Heavy Industries) to cater to small orders from hobbyists and academia.
